problem: Terminal closure repeatedly failed when the first canonical production readback was red even though a later live production deploy could already contain the same merge.
root_cause: The workflow exited immediately on a non-cancelled canonical readback failure and never reached its existing descendant-production containment proof.
prevention: Treat canonical production readback success as the preferred fast path.
On canonical failure, continue fail-closed into the existing live descendant containment proof rather than terminating immediately.
Claim terminal success only when the live production SHA contains the merge and the production contract/readiness checks pass.
Do not add a second deployment mechanism.
